name: GrainGradient
description: A four-stop linear or radial repeating gradient whose color stops travel continuously along the gradient line, finished with an SVG feTurbulence film-grain overlay and soft depth lighting.
a11yNotes: The gradient, lighting and SVG grain (focusable=false) layers are aria-hidden with pointer-events: none. The stop animation runs only while visible and speed > 0; prefers-reduced-motion shows the static starting gradient.

propsApi.name: color2
propsApi.description: Second gradient stop color (also tints the depth glow).

propsApi.name: angle
propsApi.description: Direction of the linear gradient in degrees (ignored for radial).

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Speed at which stops travel along the gradient; 1 = one cycle per 16s, 0 pauses.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
